company.name: Telr
company.shortDescription: Telr is a fintech company that provides online payment gateway and digital commerce solutions for businesses.
company.description: Telr is a fintech company that provides online payment gateway and digital commerce solutions for businesses across the Middle East and other emerging markets. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Dubai, Telr enables merchants to accept online payments through websites, mobile apps, social commerce channels, QR codes, and payment links.

productsAndServices.description: An online payment gateway for accepting card and alternative payments across websites, mobile apps, and e-commerce platforms through hosted pages, iframe integrations, APIs, plugins, and mobile SDKs.
productsAndServices.name: Telr Payment Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A set of payment gateway tools for managing transactions, recurring payments, invoices, multicurrency processing, settlements, split payments, and online business expansion.
productsAndServices.name: Telr Growth

productsAndServices.description: An anti-fraud and payment security service that uses real-time monitoring and fraud controls to help protect online transactions and improve payment acceptance.
productsAndServices.name: Telr Secure

productsAndServices.description: A social-commerce payment service that lets businesses collect payments through payment links, instant messaging, and QR codes used online, in stores, or at delivery points.
productsAndServices.name: Telr Social

productsAndServices.description: A checkout financing service, provided with Tabby, that lets shoppers pay for purchases in four interest-free monthly installments while merchants receive payment upfront.
productsAndServices.name: Telr Buy Now Pay Later

productsAndServices.description: A business financing service that provides merchants with access to business loans through an online application process.
productsAndServices.name: Telr Finance

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $1,000,000, or 3.34% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,548,546 to $122,311,593, a 14.31x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
